init.description: Initialize @thdk/nx-claude (run by `nx add`). Optionally installs the bundled nx-claude usage skill into the workspace.

plugin.description: Scaffold a new Claude plugin folder and register it in marketplace.json.

skill.description: Add a lint-clean starter skill to an existing Claude plugin and list it in the plugin README.

move-skill.description: Move a skill between plugins, updating both READMEs and rewriting plugin:skill references.

move-plugin.description: Move (and optionally rename) a plugin folder, updating marketplace sources, dependents, and skill references.

remove-skill.description: Delete a skill from a plugin, update the plugin README, and warn about dangling plugin:skill references.

remove-plugin.description: Delete a Claude plugin folder and remove its marketplace.json entries.

sync-deps.description: Sync generator: add plugin.json dependencies implied by plugin:skill references in skill markdown.

marketplace.description: Create a new, empty Claude marketplace.json.

catalog-app.description: Scaffold a static Vite + React SPA that renders the plugin catalog JSON.
